comment: Digest pin for the vendored public-site styleguide (the gateway repo remains the authored authority; this copy is a vendor, repinned only by a deliberate edit to this record). Origin note: pinned to the slice-2 branch tip c90f9f3 because its amendments declare the two catalogue component shapes (filter bar, catalogue meta line) that this catalogue consumes; when the gateway branch merges, main's bytes become identical and the pin may be re-cited to a main commit in the same deliberate act. Repinning discipline: recompute sha256 against the origin bytes and update source+sha256 together in one commit.
